name: operation-registry
description: Membrane MCP operation registry: every tool name, its independently-versioned schemaVersion/errorVersion, schema path, and closed error-code list. The resource is bounded to the caller's `protocol.read` grant; reads outside that grant return a typed rejection with no content leak.
authorityNotes: Reads return the operation registry only. The registry cannot be used to widen authority beyond `protocol.read`; a caller without the grant receives a typed `resource_access_denied` rejection and the operation list is never serialized into the response.

error.message: resources/read requires one of the grants in accessGrants: [protocol.read]; caller presented []
